notes: A GTA-style Delhi, but the author cut it back to free-roam driving with no missions, crime or roleplay, and Racing's own boundary rule settles it: with no lap and no finish condition this is Simulation, preset Vehicle Sim, not Racing - so no genre-wide P6 comes with it. Shape is the preset's world-open, one shared persistent city everyone drives around, sized to a small Delhi-inspired neighbourhood of a few connected blocks. I kept path-road-vehicle for the drivable street grid and dropped the preset's resource-shared, since nothing here is extracted or hauled; settlement-density carries the request for connected city blocks rather than scattered buildings. Interiors were explicitly ruled out - street-level exterior only - so building-interior and its P3 stay off and the build routes plain P0.
